purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The city’s first-party ArcGIS layer metadata identifies a public Polygon Parcels feature layer and safe OID. An anonymous exact-point spatial-intersection query at the unchanged WUP coordinate, requesting only OBJECTID and geometry, returned one polygon (OBJECTID 127663). A ring test confirms the point lies inside. No tax, account, APN, owner, or address attributes were requested.
registryAssessment: The first-party City of Bakersfield GIS Cadastre service publishes parcel polygons; Kern County Assessor-Recorder separately documents parcel mapping GIS. Exact WUP-point query returned one polygon with safe Esri OBJECTID only.
